description: A hosted connector for Google Search Console. Connect your Google account once and ask about your site in plain language: no Cloud project, no credentials, nothing to run or host. Eleven tools answer whole questions rather than returning rows to interpret: what dropped since last month, which queries rank well but get few clicks, which pages compete for the same search. A raw Search Analytics query is there for everything else. Read-only at Google's level: the grant asks for webmasters.readonly, so it cannot submit, index or change anything.

defaultPrompt: What changed in my Search Console clicks over the last 28 days?
Which queries rank 5 to 20 but get fewer clicks than they should?
Find pages on my site competing for the same search queries.

name: askwatch-search-console

positive.prompt: Which Search Console properties can you see?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Search Console properties the connected Google account can read (sc-domain:... and/or https://.../ entries), including askwatch.ai.

positive.prompt: How did askwatch.ai do over the last 28 days compared with the previous 28?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns clicks, impressions, CTR and average position for both windows with the change for each, naming both date ranges and the last date with data.

positive.description: Find what lost the most clicks
positive.prompt: What lost the most clicks on askwatch.ai in the last 28 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns queries or pages with the largest click losses and gains, sorted by absolute change, with low-impression noise filtered out.

positive.prompt: Which queries on askwatch.ai rank 5 to 20 with a click-through rate below normal for their position?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns queries with their average position, actual CTR and the CTR expected for that position.

positive.prompt: Is https://askwatch.ai/pricing indexed, and which canonical did Google pick?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the URL's index status, last crawl date and the canonical Google selected.

negative.description: Sitemap submission is not supported: the grant is read-only (webmasters.readonly) and there is no write tool. Expected: a refusal that explains this.
negative.prompt: Submit my sitemap https://askwatch.ai/sitemap.xml to Google.

negative.description: Indexing requests are not supported for the same reason. Expected: a refusal without trying to work around it.
Search Console settings cannot be changed. Expected: a refusal that explains the plugin is read-only.
negative.prompt: Remove askwatch.ai from my Search Console account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: eleven read-only tools over Google Search Console (overview, changes, opportunities, cannibalization, brand split, URL inspection, sitemaps and a raw Search Analytics query), connected with OAuth.
